title: Supports scale under the dilation push-forward: spt Y = λ·spt X
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, λ > 0 and X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k). Assume Y(ω) = X(η) for all test forms ω, η ∈ TestFormOn univ k whose underlying forms satisfy η = δ_λ^#ω := affinePullbackForm (λ·id) 0 ω (this is δ_{λ#}X(ω) = X(δ_λ^#ω), i.e. Y = δ_{λ#}X is the push-forward of X under δ_λ(x) = λx). Then spt Y = {λx : x ∈ spt X}, i.e. Y.support = (fun x => λ • x) '' X.support. Here, following SimonGMT and Simon 6.2.11, spt T = univ \ Z_T, where the zero region Z_T is the union of all open W with compact closure, closure W ⊆ univ, on which T vanishes (T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ TestFormOn univ k with tsupport ω ⊆ W).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) = affinePullbackForm (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P)) 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) → Y ω = X η) → Y.support = (fun x => lam • x) '' X.support
